messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar use case, the passages do **not** support placing a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the primary radar test instrument; it would fit only where the workflow needs cellular/WLAN communications signaling, non-signaling RF verification, pre-conformance, OTA signaling, or desense/interference checks around the platform’s communication links rather than radar echo/signature testing itself [7][9][10][19][43][46][52].
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Fit of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R&D / go-no-go / non-signaling / conformance-style device workflow | CMX500 Callbox materials place testing phases in Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing, and position the callbox for quick DUT connection and RF testing [50][70]. | [50][70] |
| Cellular / WLAN link validation on the platform | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, BLER, throughput, PER, application test, and IP traffic analysis [10][12]. | [10][12] |
| UAV / drone communication validation, if the A&D radar platform also includes LTE/5G/Wi‑Fi links | The UAV signaling test solution is specifically about using R&S CMX500 for UAV LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi signaling tests and multi-technology desense validation [106][107]. | [106][107] |
| Interference / desense checks between radios | CMX500 Desense Testing is described as a WLAN + cellular one-box interference / desense use case, using real WLAN, LTE, and NR connections to observe mutual interference or desense effects [52]. | [52] |
| OTA signaling workflow, if radar platform communications require OTA antenna/chamber testing | R&S CMX500 OBT is described as integrated into MVG WaveStudio so MVG antenna / multiprobe measurement systems can execute 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests [22][90]. | [22][90] |
| Non-signaling RF waveform replay / RF verification | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a non-signaling use case that can generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [46]. | [46] |
### What it does not replace in a radar workflow
| Radar-specific need | Better-supported instrument role in the passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar echo / target simulation | R&S AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation; its echo concepts include hybrid and digital modes, and the digital mode is for FMCW radar with maximum generated distance of 3000 m [30][31]. | [30][31] |
| Radar echo generation in signal-generation context | The SMW200A configuration guide lists `R&S®SMW-K78` as Radar echo generation under Fading/MIMO options [100]. | [100] |
| Radar pulse scenarios | SMB100B pulse train option `R&S®SMBB-K27` is described for radar applications using jittered or staggered pulse scenarios [101]. | [101] |
| Radar signature evaluation / EM measurement services | MVG is described as providing antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation, and electromagnetic measurements test solutions [108]. | [108] |
### Practical placement
【推論】Place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after or alongside radar subsystem testing, at the communication-link validation layer: use it for LTE/5G/Wi‑Fi signaling, non-signaling RF checks, OTA signaling, and desense/interference validation, while using radar-specific tools for radar echo, pulse, or signature evaluation [10][46][52][90][30][100][101][108].

2025RS Drone Solution › 與既有知識的關係
- [[UAV Technologies 外部資料清單]] 已保存 [[6. UAV Technologies]] 中 UAV regulation、standards、PDF 與 link hub 線索；本來源比 [[6. UAV Technologies]] 提供更完整的 drone EMC / EME test proposal 脈絡，但仍屬 Market 類簡報，缺 formal date / version。
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[Wi-Fi]] 的 signaling test 與 De-sense validation；本來源則聚焦 EMC / EME / immunity / emissions / system-level RF environment，兩者互補但不可互相替代。
- [[UAV 通訊]] 記錄 C2、telemetry、payload data、SATCOM、4G/5G、Wi‑Fi、mesh 與 MAVLink / RTPS 等通訊議題；本來源補充通訊設備、GPS、mobile radio、broadcast emissions、data communications 與 power supply 可能形成 electromagnetic environment 的測試背景。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]] 討論 detection / neutralization；本來源只在 customised solution 中列 [[CUAS System Performance Verification]]，沒有提供 counter-UAS system 的技術分類、產品或效能數字。
- [[UAV 系統方塊圖]] 整理 UAV 子系統；本來源補充 drone components 如 battery、BMS、ESC、FCM、CM、antennas 與 sensors，但未提供 specific architecture 或 BOM。

2025RS Drone Solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。
- 來源定義 [[UAV]] 為 platform vehicle，[[UAS]] 為支援 drone operation 的整體系統，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等；並列出 battery、[[BMS]]、[[ESC]]、[[Flight Control Module]]、[[Communication Module]]、antennas 與 sensors 等 drone components。
- 來源提出 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]]：standard system 包含 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]、[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS8997]]；customised solution 包含 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]。
- 商用無人機部分，來源列出 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU、[[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU、[[ETSI EN 301 489]] 系列、[[CISPR 32]] / [[EN 55032]]、[[CISPR 35]]、[[EN 61000-4-3]]、[[EN 61000-4-6]]、[[EN 61000-4-2]]、[[EN 61000-4-4]]、[[EN 61000-4-5]]、[[EN 61000-4-11]]、[[EN 61000-3-2]]、[[EN 61000-3-3]] 與 [[ISO 7637-2]] 等線索。
- 軍用 / 航太部分，來源列出 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]]、[[DEF STAN 59-411]]、[[GJB 151B]]、[[GJB 1389A]] 等標準線索，並補充 [[MIL-STD-464]] 涵蓋 external RF EME、[[HPM]]、[[EMP]]、lightning、RADHAZ、HERP / HERF / HERO、electrical bonding、TEMPEST 與 platform radiated emission 等系統層議題。
- 來源指出 commercial drone radiated RF immunity default test level 為 3 V/m、frequency range 80 MHz to 6 GHz，但也問「Is this test level adequate for all environment?」，並指出 test level 需由 drone manufacturer 依 applications 定義，例如 higher test level 10 V/m 或 specialized test level。

2025RS Drone Solution › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期、版本、作者、客戶、適用國家 / 地區或簡報完整頁數；只能以 raw 轉檔日期 2026-09-17 與檔名 `2025RS` 追溯。
- 轉檔為 lossy derivative；多個表格與標準列名存在 OCR / 排版斷裂，例如 standards based on EUT、R&S test system list、ETSI 4709-x 描述與 MIL / satellite standards 表。
- [[R&S TS8997]] 只出現代碼；來源未說明完整產品名稱或用途。
- [[MIL-STD-464]] 在來源中同時出現 464C 與 464D，未說明版本差異或適用情境。
- `Lighting` / `Lightning` 在來源中皆出現，需回 PDF 判斷是 illumination 還是 lightning / EMP 語境。
- `DAV-B` 可能為 `DVB` 或其他 broadcast emission 文字；未決。
- [[ETSI 4709-x]] 的正式標準名稱、版本與 drone network testing 關係未由來源清楚標示。
- 來源列出的 standard applicability 不等於任一 drone product 必須全部測試；測試項目需依 EUT、intended environment、regulatory domain、application 與 manufacturer requirement 定義。
- 來源列 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]，但未提供 test method、frequency plan、chamber / antenna setup、pass / fail criteria、threat waveform 或 safety condition。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › Complex EME emulation
來源的 RF electromagnetic environment 章節列出：

- emulate complex EME signals。
- enable the military electromagnetic spectrum operation。
- emulating different electromagnetic environment。
- evaluating military system level effects under EM interferences。
- simulating different operational scenarios。

這支持 [[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 的客製化測試方向，但來源未提供 signal library、scenario definition、threat emitter model、功率、頻段、同步或安全條件。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › MIL-STD-464 system-level testing
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 說 [[MIL-STD-464]] provides the basis of environment testing for vehicles that have to work in the most unforgiving condition，並將其描述為 system level testing standard。

來源列出的 main chapter / sub-items 包含：

- margins，6 dB margins。
- intra-system EMC。
- hull generated intermodulation interference / IMI。
- shipboard internal EME。
- multipaction。
- induced levels at antenna ports of antenna-connected receivers。
- external RF EME。
- [[High Power Microwave]] / HPM sources。
- lightning。
- [[Electromagnetic Pulse]] / EMP。
- subsystems and equipment electromagnetic interference / EMI。
- portable electronics devices and carry-on equipment requirements。
- non-developmental items / NDI and commercial items。
- electrostatic environments。
- radiation hazards / RADHAZ：HERP、HERF、HERO。
- life cycle / E3 hardness。
- electrical bonding、power current return path、antenna installations、mechanical interfaces、shock / fault / ignitable vapour protection。
- external grounds。
- TEMPEST。
- system radiated emission、EMCON、platform radiated emission。
- EM spectrum supportability。

passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

RF pre-conformance testing › 來源定義
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 5G NR UE 上市前需要通過符合 [[3GPP]] specifications 的 device certification。
- [[RF pre-conformance testing]] 又稱 design verification。
- RF pre-conformance testing 應在產品開發早期開始，用於及早找出並處理問題，減少延遲並提升最終產品品質。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 3GPP RF pre-conformance WebGUI solution 提供執行 **NR-FR1 Standalone（SA）** test cases 的平台，依據 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] specification。
- Manual verification capabilities 適合 early-stage validation、debugging 與 step-by-step verification。
- Test case procedures 針對 R&D use cases 最佳化，使用 specification 中最相關的 configurations。

RF pre-conformance testing › 相關 test workflow
在 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 中，RF pre-conformance workflow 連到：

- [[5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] WebGUI。
- [[R&S CMX-KC661B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- [[R&S CMsequencer]] automated execution / validation / reporting。
- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] selected test cases。

RF pre-conformance testing
[[RF pre-conformance testing]] 是在正式 device certification / conformance testing 前，於研發早期對 RF 行為進行的 design verification；在 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 中，它指 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 執行 selected 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test cases 的 WebGUI workflow。

MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓使用者可直接使用 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] [[OTA testing]] signaling tests。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 被描述為支援 full stack generation and analysis of 4G、[[5G NR]]、[[WLAN]] 與 [[LTE]] signals。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，來源稱可在 real-world conditions 下進行 precise OTA testing。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合後，來源稱 [[MVG]] systems 可處理 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- 來源稱整合支援 multiple hardware configurations of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，包括 `CMX Lite` 與 `CMX Pro`；但未提供正式料號、BOM 或與既有 [[R&S CMX500]] standard hardware configurations 的對照。
- 來源列出可支援的標準 / 場景包括 [[5G NR FR1]] SA、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]。
- 來源稱此整合可移除 earlier setups 的複雜度，減少 preparation and measurements 所需時間，並加速 development cycles。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Chief Commercial Officer 身分表示，MVG 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充測試能力到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，[[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 multi-band capabilities 可顯著簡化 OTA test setup。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- [[MVG]] 公司資訊：Microwave Vision Group 提供 electromagnetic waves visualization 技術、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 測試方案；營運於 10 個國家，90% sales from exports，revenues exceeding €100 million。

| [[Radar Systems]] | track drones over long ranges and in poor visibility。 | 未提供 radar band、range、RCS、速度範圍、clutter rejection 或小型 UAV 偵測限制。 |
| [[Optical Sensors]] | use visual and thermal imaging to detect drones。 | 未提供 EO / IR 規格、解析度、weather limitation、night performance 或 AI recognition method。 |

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 defense tool
來源整理多個 defense-oriented use cases：

- jamming detection and classification。
- GPS spoofing detection。
- UAV IDS。
- signal source identification。
- RF emitter localization。
- passive RF monitoring。
- counter-UAV detection and mitigation。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

- [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 依 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 聚焦 [[EMC]]、[[EMI]]、[[EMS]]、[[EME]]、radiated / conducted layout 與 system-level effects test。

R&S ELEKTRA › 5G FR2 test procedure support

- ELEKTRA is next generation EMC test SW。
- For 5G support of RSE measurement procedures with extension for 5G FR2。
- 支援 3D and TRP evaluation。
- 支援 5G signaling with [[R&S CMX500]]。

answer.text:
### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar use case, the passages do **not** support placing a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the primary radar test instrument; it would fit only where the workflow needs cellular/WLAN communications signaling, non-signaling RF verification, pre-conformance, OTA signaling, or desense/interference checks around the platform’s communication links rather than radar echo/signature testing itself [7][9][10][19][43][46][52].
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Fit of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| R&D / go-no-go / non-signaling / conformance-style device workflow | CMX500 Callbox materials place testing phases in Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing, and position the callbox for quick DUT connection and RF testing [50][70]. | [50][70] |
| Cellular / WLAN link validation on the platform | R&S CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, fading, BLER, throughput, PER, application test, and IP traffic analysis [10][12]. | [10][12] |
| UAV / drone communication validation, if the A&D radar platform also includes LTE/5G/Wi‑Fi links | The UAV signaling test solution is specifically about using R&S CMX500 for UAV LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi signaling tests and multi-technology desense validation [106][107]. | [106][107] |
| Interference / desense checks between radios | CMX500 Desense Testing is described as a WLAN + cellular one-box interference / desense use case, using real WLAN, LTE, and NR connections to observe mutual interference or desense effects [52]. | [52] |
| OTA signaling workflow, if radar platform communications require OTA antenna/chamber testing | R&S CMX500 OBT is described as integrated into MVG WaveStudio so MVG antenna / multiprobe measurement systems can execute 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests [22][90]. | [22][90] |
| Non-signaling RF waveform replay / RF verification | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a non-signaling use case that can generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [46]. | [46] |
### What it does not replace in a radar workflow
| Radar-specific need | Better-supported instrument role in the passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar echo / target simulation | R&S AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation; its echo concepts include hybrid and digital modes, and the digital mode is for FMCW radar with maximum generated distance of 3000 m [30][31]. | [30][31] |
| Radar echo generation in signal-generation context | The SMW200A configuration guide lists `R&S®SMW-K78` as Radar echo generation under Fading/MIMO options [100]. | [100] |
| Radar pulse scenarios | SMB100B pulse train option `R&S®SMBB-K27` is described for radar applications using jittered or staggered pulse scenarios [101]. | [101] |
| Radar signature evaluation / EM measurement services | MVG is described as providing antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation, and electromagnetic measurements test solutions [108]. | [108] |
### Practical placement
【推論】Place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after or alongside radar subsystem testing, at the communication-link validation layer: use it for LTE/5G/Wi‑Fi signaling, non-signaling RF checks, OTA signaling, and desense/interference validation, while using radar-specific tools for radar echo, pulse, or signature evaluation [10][46][52][90][30][100][101][108].

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。

主要能力與限制：

UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions › 與 signaling test 的區分
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] 依 [[Signaling test solution]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 UAV [[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test 與 De-sense validation。
- [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 依 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 聚焦 [[EMC]]、[[EMI]]、[[EMS]]、[[EME]]、radiated / conducted layout 與 system-level effects test。

兩者可同屬 drone test solution 線索，但不可把 CMX500 signaling option 自動推論為 EMC / EME test system，也不可把 EMC 系統推論為 cellular / WLAN protocol tester。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- 來源 frontmatter 顯示原始檔為 `CMX500_Callbox.pptx`，由 markitdown 轉出，converted date 為 2026-09-17；投影片中另出現日期 **05.01.2026**，但日期格式未標示。
- 簡報將測試階段分為 [[Go-NoGo Testing]]、[[Non-Sig Testing]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 與 [[R&D Testing]]，並以 [[R&S CMX500]] callbox 作為可快速建立 call、進行 RF testing、mobility testing 與 application testing 的平台。
- Callbox focus 包含 [[RF Testing]]、[[3GPP pre-conformance]]、[[Mobility Testing]]、[[Application Testing]]、[[Network Slicing]]、[[IP Throughput]]、[[Security Analysis]]、[[Backend Service]]、[[IMS Services]]、[[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]、[[ATSSS]]、[[Power Consumption]]、[[XR Responsiveness & L4S]]、[[eCall]] / [[NGeCall]] 與 [[Speech Quality]]。
- 來源描述 [[CMsquares]] 為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI 的介面，並列出 live views、app testing、NTN live views、sequencer、log analysis 與 one-click RF testing。
- [[RF SA Preconformance]] 部分宣稱可在 GUI 中快速開始 manual 3GPP RF pre-conformance，並提到 automatic configuration of parameters per TC、25 TCs、dynamic workspace per TC、NR-NTN / NSA / LTE coming、release 時有 comprehensive App Note，連結為 `https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/1C111`。
- [[CMSequencer]] 部分描述可由 manual 快速切換到 automated pre-conformance，使用 same technology specific license，並引用 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`；來源圖表列出 RF pre-conformance TC count：category 7.1 為 3GPP 43、7.4 為 68、7.6 為 134、8.3 為 3GPP 159 / RED 33 / WiFi 92。
- R&D automation / RF pathloss calibration 部分描述 predefined blocks、mix & match、PL from signaling measurements + reports、GPRF measurements 與 NRP Power Meter；來源 notes 稱 NRP slightly more precise、GPRF 會包含 connector + additional RF path、golden device 最容易但 least precise。

CMX500 Desense Testing
[[CMX500 Desense Testing]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中描述的 WLAN + cellular one-box interference / desense use case：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 在真實連線下同時處理 WLAN、LTE 與 NR 測試，觀察互相干擾或 desense 影響。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing
[[MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing]] 是 [[MVG]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中描述的整合測試情境：將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[MVG]] 的 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，讓 [[MVG]] antenna / multiprobe measurement systems 可直接執行 [[5G NR]]、[[RedCap]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[WLAN]] OTA signaling tests。[[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]] 將此情境擴充到 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。

UAV signaling test solution
[[UAV signaling test solution]] 是以 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 UAV 常見的 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] 通訊鏈路進行 single-technology signaling test 與 multi-technology De-sense validation 的市場方案線索。

UAV 通訊 › Signaling test 與驗證線索
[[Signaling test solution]] 指出 [[R&S CMX500]] 可針對 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 提供 single-technology signaling test；其 RF frequency range 在來源中寫為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer tests：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

詳細配置線索見 [[UAV signaling test solution]]。使用限制：[[Signaling test solution]] 是 Market 類 OneNote solution note，未標示正式 configuration guide、軟體版本、license bundle、test case、pass / fail criteria 或 measurement uncertainty；正式規格仍需查 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]。

- [[MVG]] 的全名為 Microwave Vision Group。
- 提供 cutting-edge technologies for visualizing electromagnetic waves。
- 其 advanced test solutions 用於 antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements。
- 支援 company R&D teams innovate and boost product development。
- 營運於 10 個國家。
- 90% sales from exports。
- Group revenues exceeding €100 million。
